exercise.title: G-Em-C-D, full pattern
exercise.why: This pattern keeps the hand moving down and up on every half beat, so the strums it leaves out are what make the groove.

cells.text: Press Play below to start the metronome. Strum the pattern shown in the boxes on each chord, and keep your hand moving down and up even where it misses the strings. Stay on it until the pattern swings on its own.
